curiocatalogue:guide-text:
Curio Catalogue is about collecting. Its heart is the album: a book that knows your whole collection, shows what you are still missing and takes new pieces straight from a chest. The first collection is tapestries. Next to the album live two plain books for keeping stock, the ledger and the bill of materials.

Your first book
Put a vanilla book book-normal-teal|book-normal-cherryred|book-aged-orange in the middle of the crafting grid, nails and strips metalnailsandstrips-iron above and below it, and ink and quill inkandquill to its right. You get a ledger with 8 sheets and the cover of the book you used. Anything written in that book is lost. The lucky ones who find a large book in ruins can restore it with a jug of lime water and ink and quill: that ledger has 32 sheets.

The album
An empty ledger or bill of materials and any tapestry piece tapestry-north in the crafting grid make an album curiocatalogue:book-album-normal-brickred; the piece stays. The album lists every tapestry as missing. Hold it, or keep it in your off-hand with the main hand empty, and press shift + rightmouse on a chest: it takes one of each missing piece into your inventory and crosses them off. Duplicates stay in the chest. If your inventory runs out of room, it takes what fits, picture by picture.
rightmouse into the air opens the album: it shows what is missing and how many pieces and whole pictures you have, and has a search. The Start over button makes everything missing again.

Want lists
The Want list button in the album window writes everything still missing onto a separate list; this costs one sheet. Give it to a friend: when they press shift + rightmouse on a chest, the list moves what it names from the chest into your friend's inventory and crosses it off. Handing the finds over to you is up to your friend; the list only gathers. When the list is done, it turns into parchment.

Ledger and bill of materials
The ledger notes which kinds of items there are, the bill of materials how many of each; an empty book alone in the crafting grid switches between them. With a book in hand, shift + rightmouse on a container makes an incoming invoice for what the book lacks, shift + ctrl + rightmouse an outgoing invoice for what it lists. Then take the invoice in hand and press shift + rightmouse on any container to post it: the items move into your inventory. With the book in your off-hand it is updated and gets its sheet back; without it the invoice becomes parchment.

Sheets and covers
Each invoice and each want list costs a sheet. An invoice or a want list can be cancelled in its window: no items move, and its sheet goes back into the book in your off-hand; without one it becomes parchment. Add sheets with parchment in the crafting grid, up to the limit (32 by default). Dyed leather recolours a book, and a jug with sulfuric acid ages its cover.
curiocatalogue:handbook-use-ledger-text: Notes which kinds of items there are, without counts. With the ledger in hand, or in your off-hand with the main hand empty, shift + rightmouse on a container makes an incoming invoice for the items the ledger does not list yet, shift + ctrl + rightmouse an outgoing invoice for the items it lists; posted, it takes all of them from the container. Post invoices with the ledger in your off-hand to keep it up to date. rightmouse into the air opens the ledger: its entries, search, sorting, a name and Clear. An empty ledger alone in the crafting grid becomes a bill of materials, with any tapestry piece an album. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.
curiocatalogue:handbook-use-materials-te: Notes how many of each item there are: a shopping list for a project that shrinks by itself. An incoming invoice posted with the list in your off-hand adds its items with their counts. Then, with the list in hand or in your off-hand, shift + ctrl + rightmouse on a container makes an outgoing invoice for what the list still asks for, up to its counts. Post it with the list in your off-hand, chest after chest: what stays in the list is what you still lack. Without the list in your off-hand an invoice leaves it unchanged, so the list works as a template. shift + rightmouse makes an incoming invoice for what is over the counts. An empty bill of materials alone in the crafting grid becomes a ledger, with any tapestry piece an album. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.
curiocatalogue:handbook-use-album-text: Knows the whole collection and lists what is still missing; the first collection is tapestries. With the album in hand, or in your off-hand with the main hand empty, shift + rightmouse on a chest takes one of each missing piece into your inventory and crosses it off; duplicates stay in the chest. rightmouse into the air opens the album: what is missing, how many pieces and whole pictures you have, and a search. Start over makes everything missing again; Want list writes what is missing onto a want list for a friend. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.
curiocatalogue:handbook-sheets-text: Each invoice (incoming or outgoing) and each want list costs a sheet. Posting or cancelling an invoice with the book in your off-hand gives the sheet back; without the book the invoice turns into parchment, and so does a finished want list. Add sheets with parchment in the crafting grid, one per piece, up to the limit (32 by default); what does not fit stays.
curiocatalogue:handbook-cover-text: The cover comes from the vanilla book; a restored large book is dark green. Dyed leather recolours a book, a jug with 1 litre of sulfuric acid ages its cover (teal and purple do not age).
curiocatalogue:item-handbooktext-curioca: Lists what a container had and the book lacked. Take it in hand and press shift + rightmouse on any container to post it: the items move into your inventory, and a book in your off-hand adds them and gets its sheet back. Without a book there the invoice becomes parchment. rightmouse into the air shows the invoice; it can be cancelled there. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.

Lists what a container had of the book's entries. Take it in hand and press shift + rightmouse on any container to post it: the items move into your inventory, and a book in your off-hand crosses them off and gets its sheet back. Without a book there the invoice becomes parchment. rightmouse into the air shows the invoice; it can be cancelled there. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.

What an album still misses, made in the album window to give to a friend. Whoever holds it presses shift + rightmouse on a chest: the list takes what it names into their inventory and crosses it off. When the list is done, it turns into parchment. rightmouse into the air shows the list; it can be cancelled there. More in the Curio Catalogue guide.
